bio: The Riverside House Hotel is situated on the River Lark on the outskirts of Mildenhall, close to Newmarket and Bury St Edmunds.  The historic hotel was originally built in 1720 as a house and is now an elegant family run hotel, serving a traditional Afternoon Tea.  Enjoy a selection of finger sandwiches, chefs’ selection of cakes and pastries and freshly baked scones with clotted cream and jam, served with your choice of tea or coffee.  The savoury Afternoon Tea menu includes a selection of pies, pasties and a sausage roll, selection of cheeses with pickles, warm crusty bread and butter, served with your choice of soft drink, tea or coffee.  The Garden Room restaurant extends out into the garden area, with seating alongside the River, which is very popular among families and dog lovers.
